mod-description: Gear-driven workshop machines and limited automation.
handbook-text-fluid-pipe-copper:
Carries liquid or steam through connected ports. Place it against the face it should connect to; sneak while placing to open the opposite face instead. Use a wrench on a face to open or close that port.

rightmouse a free face with plain glass, a Steel Sprinkler (bottom face only), a Copper Pipe Nozzle (any face), or a copper plate (an open port facing air). Sneak and rightmouse with an empty hand to remove a fitting.
handbook-text-creative-fluid-pump: Creative-only source for a connected Copper Pipe. rightmouse to choose liquid or steam and set 0-1000 kPa; 0 stops the source.
handbook-text-passive-fluid-pump: Legacy block with no current function. Use a Copper Pipe Nozzle to connect a pipe to an unsealed liquid container.
handbook-text-sprinkler-brass: rightmouse the bottom face of a Copper Pipe to attach it. Water reaches farmland one to four blocks below; higher pressure increases its circular reach from one to four blocks. Steam will not pass through it, and other liquids kill affected crops.
handbook-text-irrigator-pipe-bronze: Place in a straight horizontal run below solid ceiling blocks; it follows the direction you face and connects at its ends. It waters the first farmland one to four blocks below its three outlets, up to 80% moisture. Steam will not irrigate, and other liquids kill affected crops. See the Copper Pipe for a configurable supply line.
handbook-text-fluid-pipe-intake-copper: rightmouse any free face of a Copper Pipe to attach it. It transfers liquid to or from an adjacent unsealed container. Pointing it sideways or down into open air deletes liquid; pointing it up releases overflow only. Sneak and rightmouse with an empty hand to remove it.
handbook-text-pottery-profile-tool: Creative-only item with no gameplay action.
handbook-text-small-flywheel: Place inline with a horizontal Wooden Axle; the 3 by 3 by 1 space around its shaft must be clear. It stores momentum while the network speeds up and returns it when the network slows. When isolated it keeps a one-block mechanical network, then automatically joins a compatible drivetrain that reconnects. It does not create power, and each flywheel adds resistance.
handbook-text-overrunning-transmission: Place it inline by clicking the source-side axle; that side becomes the input. Its two ends remain separate mechanical networks. The ratchet transfers rotation only while the input leads the output in the allowed direction. A faster output, stopped input, or reversed input freewheels without back-driving the source. Break and replace the block from the other end to reverse its input side.
handbook-text-controlled-clutch: Gearwright keeps the shafts on the two ends of this transmission as separate mechanical networks. An adjacent Clutch exchanges rotation between them while engaged without joining or rebuilding either network. Disengaging it stops the exchange but leaves both networks intact.
flywheel-state-read-only: Flywheel inertia is disabled because its saved state uses an unsupported schema.
controlled-clutch-waiting: Waiting for a mechanical network on both shaft ends.
controlled-clutch-bypassed: Both ends are already joined by another mechanical path.
pipe-content-conflict: That change would join pipe networks containing different contents.
block-placefailure-gearwright-irrigator-: The Irrigator Pipe cannot be supported at that location.
hydraulic-status-running: Pipe network is settling pressure and contents.
hydraulic-status-waiting-for-chunks: Waiting for connected chunks to load.
hydraulic-status-mixed-content: Connected pipes contain different contents; transfer is stopped.
hydraulic-status-mixed-sources: Different sources are trying to fill this empty network.
hydraulic-status-content-mismatch: A connected source or container has the wrong content.
hydraulic-status-gas-container-blocked: Steam cannot enter a Vintage Story liquid container.
hydraulic-status-invalid-content: The selected pipe content is unavailable.
hydraulic-status-no-source: No usable liquid container is connected.
hydraulic-status-reserve-reached: The old horizontal reserve has been reached.
hydraulic-status-deprecated: This Gravity Drain is deprecated; use a Copper Pipe Nozzle.
